question: Are architectural sex-allocation variants genetically available AND able to establish when rare under ecological mating constraints?

mating_2007.experimental_scope: Artificial arrays in Oxford field station, 2003 density-only hermaphrodites and 2004 with or without 50% males
mating_2007.female_function_phenotype: Allohexaploid hermaphrodites (6x), Spanish populations 506 and 660, maternal plants
mating_2007.offspring_male_sired_ploidy: 4x progeny; discrimination against diploid pollen by hexaploid stigmas is a known confound

male_fecundity_vs_hermaphrodite_siring_b.source_note: Experiment male and hermaphrodite pollen contribute differently; one cannot treat SE as raw independent individual-based interval

invasion_model.source_natural_paradox: Some dense hermaphrodite-only regional populations lacked males despite the model indicating that migrants could invade; interpreted as dispersal/colonization history, not demonstrated causal stasis

genetic_2026.target: Diploid XY natural sex system, experimental XX female-only lines progressively produce male flowers
genetic_2026.original_sex_chromosome: XY/Y male determination absent in X-only lines

suggestive_but_incomplete_tradeoff.female_effect: same opposite direction but female QTL single-QTL test just missed p<.05

same_direction_region.reported_effect: Positive effect on both male and female reproductive effort

trait_specific_region.reported_effect: One of male and female reproductive efforts changed without counterpart

confounds: QTL credible intervals often span broad pericentromeric non-recombining regions
multiple linked physical genes possible rather than verified one-gene antagonistic pleiotropy
segregation distortion in crosses 1,3,4; overlapping distortion regions removed
genetic_2026.measures: Allocation traits and QTL in XX lines, not achieved rare re-invasion of XY males or actual long-term per allele establishment

archive.github_workflow_reference: Snakemake on GitHub, original source article link

natural_geography_2026.cite: Nguyen & Pannell (2026) Journal of Evolutionary Biology (published 13 June 2026)
natural_geography_2026.target: Diploid dioecious wild-derived male and female plants grown in common garden across European geographic range
natural_geography_2026.environmental_explanation: Greater leaky-expression incidence toward range margins consistent with reproductive assurance under colonization, but study is cross-sectional correlation of geographic populations, not realized colonization fitness experiment

inferential_firewall.cross_ploidy_cohort_bridge: BLOCKED: 2007 diploid male × allohexaploid hermaphrodite arrays cannot estimate population dynamics or allele fitness of 2026 diploid XX evolving plants
inferential_firewall.2007_no_rare_frequency: 2004 array male frequency 0 or 50%; rare male invasion is derived from author's density+selfing model, not observed low-frequency invasion
inferential_firewall.2003_vs_2004: 2003 density-only experiments show gradient; 2004 factorial density was not significant. Keep separate
inferential_firewall.QTL_vs_development: 2006–2026 study-level genotype linkage does not prove a single pleiotropic gene; large credible intervals and segregation distortion
inferential_firewall.data_level: Published source data and equations checked; no imported raw phenotype, genotype or 2026 range-expansion individual records
inferential_firewall.nonindependent_studies: 2025 New Phytologist and 2026 PNAS use the same experimentally evolved diploid XX founder lineages; not independent natural origins
inferential_firewall.prior_art: Density-dependent inferred male invasion and sexual allocation antagonism/QTL are established prior art, not SLK novelty
